verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents Wrangler as its official command-line tool, and its commands page explicitly covers creating, developing and deploying Workers from the terminal. Related CLI operations such as `wrangler rollback` and `npm create cloudflare` are also documented, so the deploy workflow does not depend on the dashboard. missing for 10: no verbatim quote of the specific deploy command or its options, no independent hands-on report confirming CLI-only deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
To roll back to a specified version of your Worker via Wrangler, use the [`wrangler rollback`](/workers/wrangler/commands/general/#rollback) command.
